title: Section 96 CPC — First appeal from a decree

content.overview: A first appeal lies from every original decree unless a statute shuts it out. Consent decrees do not appeal. Ex parte decrees may.
content.study: Appeal the decree, not the judgment. Small-cause-nature suits below the enacted value appeal only on law. Commercial and other special statutes can cut this right. Check limitation and the forum under the Civil Courts Act.
